name: agentsop-aider
title: 终端结对编程的操作系统
description: SOP for terminal-based, git-native AI pair programming with Aider (git work-tree + tree-sitter repo-map + edit-format + human-in-loop REPL). Use when editing code in an existing git repo via an LLM, when you need to converge a change to 2-5 files, pick an edit format that fits the model, run architect+editor mode, or wire an auto-test loop.
